name: Hyderabadi Birria-Style Chicken Tacos
classification_note: Overlaps approved Goat Birria in technique; chicken variant, lower cost. Not a replacement.
cooking_method: Marinate, braise chicken in guajillo-ancho-Hyderabadi marinade to 74 °C, crisp tacos on comal

portion.construction: shredded braised chicken, cheese, dipped tortillas crisped on comal, broth cup

steps: Braise covered at about 150 °C oven or gentle simmer until tender; core 74 °C minimum; skim fat; shred.
Dip tortillas in the braise fat, fill with chicken and cheese, crisp on a hot comal; serve with the strained broth.

plating: Three tacos with a small cup of broth, onion, cilantro, lime.
food_safety: Poultry to 74 °C; braise/broth cooled by two-stage rule and reheated to 74 °C for service.
Hot-hold broth ≥ 57 °C; discard rules per policy.

research.practice: Birria is a Jalisco braised-meat dish with guajillo-ancho adobo, typically beef/goat; Hyderabadi cooking uses yogurt-spice marinades and dum braises.
research.nasha_combination: Chicken in a Hyderabadi-guajillo marinade as 'birria-style' tacos is a NASHA proposal and not authentic birria.
